name: ThirdShotHub Rally Indoor 26
description: The ThirdShotHub Rally Indoor 26 is a six-pack of indoor balls drilled with 26 larger holes, which is the indoor pattern — fewer, wider holes than an outdoor ball so the ball carries on a gym floor without the wind loading an outdoor ball is built for. The seamless rotational-molded shell is softer than an outdoor ball and will crack quickly if taken onto concrete, which is the single most common misuse.

specifications.certification: USA Pickleball approved for indoor sanctioned play

care_instructions: Indoor only. Playing these on outdoor concrete will crack the shell within a session or two and is not covered by any return. Store between 50F and 80F — a cold ball plays dead and a hot one goes soft and out of round. Retire a ball once it is visibly out of round or has a hairline crack; a cracked ball bounces unpredictably and is not legal for sanctioned play.
